items.raw_excerpt: Haworth has been named one of the most beautiful places in England by The Times thanks to its cobbled streets and links to literature
items.summary_en: Haworth, a village in Yorkshire, was named one of the most beautiful places in England by The Times. It is known for its cobbled streets and its links to famous writers.

items.summary_en: A women's chess team called She Plays to Win Lionesses won promotion to the top flight of competitive chess. The league has a rule that female teams must include a male player. The team earned a place in the top division.

items.summary_en: A five-bedroom family home in Carlton-in-Cleveland is on the market. The asking price is £1.25 million. The estate agent says the home is special and unlikely to stay on the market for long.

items.raw_excerpt: À environ une heure de Lyon, Lhuis se cache au cœur du Bugey dans un décor où les vignes, les vieilles pierres et les paysages sauvages se rencontrent. Un petit village encore largement épargné par le tourisme de masse, parfait pour une escapade loin de l’agitation lyonnaise.
items.summary_en: Lhuis is a small village about an hour from Lyon, tucked away in the Bugey countryside. It mixes vineyards, old stone houses, and wild landscapes. It is still mostly free of mass tourism, perfect for a quiet escape from Lyon.
items.summary_ko: 뤼이는 리옹에서 약 한 시간 거리, 뷔제 지방 한가운데에 숨어 있는 작은 마을이다. 포도밭과 오래된 돌집, 야생의 풍경이 어우러져 있다. 아직 대중 관광에 크게 알려지지 않아 리옹의 번잡함을 벗어나 조용히 떠나기 좋은 곳이다.
items.title_en: Lhuis, a hidden village near Lyon, is a gem of vines, heritage and nature

items.title_original: À 1h de Lyon, ce village méconnu de l’Ain est une pépite entre vignes, patrimoine et nature - Le Bonbon

items.raw_excerpt: Calicut University launches 'ASCENT' to enhance academic standards and foster growth in its 445 affiliated colleges across Kerala.
items.summary_en: Calicut University in Kerala announced a new program called 'ASCENT'. The plan aims to raise academic standards at its 445 affiliated colleges. The university hopes the program will also help the colleges grow.

items.raw_excerpt: From one extreme to the other within months in this lovely Cornish spot Residents in what became the UK's 'wettest place' are now grappling with a ...
items.summary_en: A village in Cornwall became known as the UK's wettest place after 55 straight days of rain. Now residents are dealing with a heatwave. The weather swung from one extreme to the other within months.
